title: France: Curfews issued in Paris, Nice after unrest
summary: French authorities imposed curfews in parts of several cities on Monday night after cost-of-living and anti-government protests descended into rioting and looting over the weekend. DW has the latest.

image.caption: Workers are repairing the damage after rioters caused damage to shops and businesses in French cities over the weekend Image: Christophe Ena/AP Photo/picture alliance

Welcome to DW's coverage of the continuing civil unrest and protests in France and other European countries.
Curfews were declared in several French cities on Monday evening, including in parts of Paris, as authorities looked to prevent a continuation of protests, rioting and looting.
